worked_solution:
To find the complex conjugate of a vector, we take the complex conjugate of the entries of the vector. So, we have

$$
\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{x} & =\overset{―}{[\begin{aligned}9-6\text{i} \\ 9-3\text{i} \\ -3\end{aligned}]} \\  & =[\begin{aligned}\overset{―}{9-6\text{i}} \\ \overset{―}{9-3\text{i}} \\ \overset{―}{-3}\end{aligned}] \\  & =[\begin{aligned}9+6\text{i} \\ 9+3\text{i} \\ -3\end{aligned}].\end{aligned}
$$
